title: The box's own history
question: Does the HISTORY page read as the box's history? What's missing from a row?
context_md:
New: every founding line that has ended now gets a record, in two places built from the same `LineEnded` log event so they can never disagree -- a HISTORY page (`F5`, or the LOG page's own row) and a text file exported on REBUILD and on quit.

Pictured: the default bed (`herb`/`ant`, seed 1), warmed to frame 5752 through `examples/labui.rs`'s own scripted click-through (LOG -> HISTORY). 47 lines have ended by that point in the sheet's run -- close to the ~45-by-frame-5000 estimate this was scoped against, so the page is showing a full, scrolled table rather than three rows in empty space.

Below are the first 25 lines of the exported chronicle file from a separate but identically-seeded run (default bed, same warmup, no extra script actions after it) -- `chronicle-2026-09-10-herb_ant-s1.txt`, written by `Lab::write_chronicle` through the same `format_log_line` the LOG page itself draws through. That run stops at the same frame (5752) but earlier in its own script, so its own count is 43, not 47 -- both numbers are real, they're just two different amounts of the same deterministic run.

